analogy.rationale: Lipoxygenase inhibitors block arachidonic acid metabolism, sharing the eicosanoid pathway with cyclooxygenase inhibitors and anti-inflammatory agents; because these cells express little ALOX5 and the transcriptional readout of enzyme inhibition is limited, the response should be weak.
